mapper.sql: ur.assignment_id as "assignmentId", ur.user_id as "userId", u.login_id as "loginId", u.employee_no as "employeeNo", k.name as "name", ur.role_code as "roleCode", r.role_name as "roleName", ur.assignment_type as "assignmentType", ur.valid_start_date as "validStartDate", ur.valid_end_date as "validEndDate", ur.approver_user_id as "approverUserId", approver_k.name as "approverName", ur.status as "status", ur.revoked_at as "revokedAt", ur.revoked_by as "revokedBy", ur.updated_at as "updatedAt", ur.change_reason as "changeReason"

from user_roles ur join users u on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots k on k.employee_no = u.employee_no join roles r on r.role_code = ur.role_code left join users approver_u on approver_u.user_id = ur.approver_user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots approver_k on approver_k.employee_no = approver_u.employee_no

select
where ur.user_id = #{userId} and ur.status = 'ACTIVE' and ur.valid_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE and (ur.valid_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE or ur.valid_end_date is null) order by ur.assignment_type, ur.role_code limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from user_roles ur where ur.user_id = #{userId} and ur.status = 'ACTIVE' and ur.valid_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE and (ur.valid_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE or ur.valid_end_date is null)
select count(*) from users where user_id = #{userId} and status != 'DELETED'
select count(*) from roles where role_code = #{roleCode} and status = 'ACTIVE' and system_use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: insert into user_roles (user_id, role_code, assignment_type, valid_start_date, valid_end_date, approver_user_id, status, change_reason) values (#{userId}, #{roleCode}, #{assignmentType}, #{validStartDate}, #{validEndDate}, #{approverUserId}, 'ACTIVE', #{changeReason})
mapper.update: update user_roles set user_id = #{userId}, role_code = #{roleCode}, assignment_type = #{assignmentType}, valid_start_date = #{validStartDate}, valid_end_date = #{validEndDate}, approver_user_id = #{approverUserId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, change_reason = #{changeReason} where assignment_id = #{assignmentId} and status = 'ACTIVE'

update user_roles set status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, revoked_by = #{revokedBy}, approver_user_id = #{revokedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, change_reason = #{changeReason} where assignment_id = #{assignmentId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
